Reproduce that exact individual — same facial structure, same hairline and hair shape, same stubble, same eye colour, same head-to-body ratio, same shoulder width, same limb length. ROLE/PURPOSE: the master anchor image for the armed version of the player-controlled protagonist of a 2D side-scrolling roguelite. Every other weapon and every armed animation is aligned against this image.
SUBJECT: the character from the reference image, holding a plain straight one-handed sword, simple crossguard, wrapped grip in his right hand.
POSE: standing upright and relaxed, weight balanced on both feet, body facing the viewer as the VIEW specifies. The right arm hangs naturally down at the side with a slight bend at the elbow, the hand closed around the weapon's grip at hip height. The weapon is held loosely, pointing diagonally DOWN and FORWARD so its tip is near the ground beside the front foot. The left arm hangs relaxed and empty. This is a calm resting stance, not a combat guard: the weapon is carried, not raised.
VIEW: strict orthographic SIDE VIEW facing RIGHT, no perspective.
Show the figure in profile facing right, the weapon arm on the far side so the blade is partly hidden behind the legs, and the tip pointing forward and down.
ART DIRECTION: Dark-fantasy woodcut / late-medieval engraving. Every form is built as carved layered facets with hard chiselled edges and dense fine hatching strokes for shading. Absolutely NO soft gradients, NO smooth airbrushing, NO glossy anime rendering. Muted desaturated earth palette ONLY: ink outline #1a1611, shadow #251f18, body #393126, lit plane #655a49, top highlight #8a7d68. Skin #6b5a48. The single warm accent permitted in the whole image is a faint ember-orange #ff7a3c glint in the eyes. Light source is fixed at upper-left on every asset. Four-layer shading convention throughout: dark outline, body mass, lit face, small highlight.
GAME-SCALE READ: at 96x144 px the head, the shoulder line, the gripping hand and the weapon's silhouette must all be instantly readable; the figure must read as a carved wooden effigy, never as a cartoon.
TECHNICAL OUTPUT: single isolated character, native size 96x144 px, fully transparent background (real alpha channel, no checkerboard, no white or coloured matte). The character stands on the bottom edge with the feet at the very bottom, centred horizontally, no perspective distortion. The weapon is PART OF THIS IMAGE — draw it attached to the hand, in the same rendering style and palette, as if it were always there. Do not draw the weapon as a separate object floating beside the figure.
LOCKS: preserve the character's identity, stocky proportions, head shape, palette and line weight exactly as in the reference; preserve the upper-left light direction; keep the same carved-woodcut rendering language.
EXCLUDE: text, labels, watermarks, mockup frames, borders, background scenery, ground, floor shadow, duplicate characters, cropped edges, signature, UI chrome, colour swatches. Do not add a shield, a second weapon, armour, a helmet, a cape or any other equipment: the character wears only the plain underlayer and holds exactly one weapon.
